_comment: The draft.json of the live record draft-controller-admin-petstore on krateo-057 (krateo-preview), read 2026-10-01: a controller PUBLISHED before frontend#405 round 2 — its lock has no servedVersion, its document says info.version 1.0.27, and its CRD serves v1-0-27.

files.Chart.yaml:
apiVersion: v2
name: petstore
description: Krateo controller for Swagger Petstore - OpenAPI 3.0, served in petstore.example.io.
type: application
version: 0.1.0
annotations:
  controller.builders.krateo.io/api-group: petstore.example.io
  controller.builders.krateo.io/base-url: https://petstore3.swagger.io/api/v3
files.templates/restdefinition-pet.yaml:
apiVersion: ogen.krateo.io/v1alpha1
kind: RestDefinition
metadata:
  name: petstore-pet
  namespace: '{{ .Release.Namespace }}'
  annotations:
    controller.builders.krateo.io/operations: pet
spec:
  oasPath: configmap://{{ .Release.Namespace }}/petstore-oas/openapi.json
  resource:
    kind: Pet
    verbsDescription:
      - action: create
        method: POST
        path: /pet
      - action: get
        method: GET
        path: /pet/{petId}
        fieldMapping:
          - inCustomResource: spec.id
            inPath: petId
      - action: findby
        method: GET
        path: /pet/findByStatus
      - action: update
        method: PUT
        path: /pet
      - action: delete
        method: DELETE
        path: /pet/{petId}
        fieldMapping:
          - inCustomResource: spec.id
            inPath: petId
    identifiers:
      - id
  resourceGroup: petstore.example.io

name: petstore
